label: original-phase new token after an earlier q/y/e/g/3
explanation: Almost entirely an original-phase unit (99% of mass), never at t=0-1, peaking at t=3-5. It fires on the first occurrence of an input token that is not in the group {q,y,e,g,3,t,x,f,s,b,a}, most strongly for m,o,k,2,h,i, and only when an earlier input belonged to the group q/y/e/g/3. q and y are the strongest drivers: prev2_tok=y has 3.6x lift, first_tok=y/q 3.5x, and every top example has q or y early in the sequence. Activation is graded and looks like several pieces of evidence added together (a q/y prefix, a favored current token, a new token, a middle position), so the boolean predicate captures about 80% of the mass but has low precision (~0.37). Nearly silent on the delimiter and in the copy phase, and does not fire on repeated tokens (in_first=0 has 0.2x lift) or when the current input is itself q/y/e/g/3/t/x/f/s/b/a.
